home.title: Your Rooms
home.empty: You are not in any Room yet. Create one, or join with a code from your Room Admin.

room.name: Room name
room.timeZonePick: This country has more than one time zone. Choose one.
room.joinCodeHint: Share this code. Every request still needs Admin approval.
room.joinBody: Enter the code your Room Admin shared with you.
room.requestSent: Request sent. You can enter the Room once an Admin approves it.
room.noExpenses: No expenses yet. Add the first one.
room.leaveConfirm: Leave this Room? You will need Admin approval to rejoin.
room.balancesNote: Paid minus share. Positive means the Room owes this member; negative means they owe the Room.
room.leaveExplain: Leaving removes you from the Room. Your past expenses stay in its history and you will need Admin approval to join again. Settle what you owe first.
room.inviteFallback: Copy this message and send it:

expense.title: What was it for?
expense.split: Split equally among everyone active on this date.
expense.deleteConfirm: Delete this expense? It will be removed from totals but stay in history.
expense.editWindow: You can edit or delete your own expense for 30 minutes after adding it.
expense.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with up to {{decimals}} decimal places.
expense.paidByYou: You (whoever adds the expense is the payer)

errors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.room_not_found: No Room found with that code. Check it and try again.
errors.already_requested_or_member: You have already requested to join, or you are already a member.
errors.not_pending: This request has already been handled.
errors.last_admin: The last Admin can't do this. Make another member an Admin first.
errors.not_approved_member: This person is not an approved member.
errors.not_member: You are not a member of this Room.
errors.future_date: The date can't be in the future.
errors.payer_not_member: The payer must be an approved member.
errors.edit_not_allowed: This expense can no longer be edited. Members can edit their own expense for 30 minutes.
errors.delete_not_allowed: This expense can no longer be deleted. Members can delete their own expense for 30 minutes.
errors.no_active_members_on_date: No members were active in the Room on that date.
errors.invalid_time_zone: Please choose a valid time zone.
errors.cycle_locked: This cycle is settled and locked. Ask an Admin to add an adjustment instead.
errors.before_room_start: That date is before this Room started.
errors.participant_not_active: A selected member was not in the Room on that date.
errors.cycle_not_ended: This cycle started today — there is nothing to settle yet.
errors.settlement_unbalanced: Totals don't match — settlement was not created.
errors.proof_required: Add a screenshot or a transaction reference for non-cash payments.
errors.other_admin_must_confirm: Another Admin must confirm your own payment.
errors.currency_change_not_allowed: Currency can't change now. It can change at the start of a new cycle, before the first expense, once the previous cycle is settled.
errors.room_has_members: Remove all other members before deleting the Room.
errors.room_has_unsettled_cycle: Settle all cycles before deleting the Room.
errors.mandatory_notification: This notification can't be turned off.
errors.already_flagged: You have already raised a dispute on this item.
errors.other_admin_must_resolve: Another Admin must resolve a dispute about your own item.
errors.invalid_token: Could not register this phone for notifications.
errors.minor_not_allowed: Accounts for people under 18 need a parent or guardian's consent. This option is coming soon.
errors.dob_invalid: Please check your date of birth.
errors.consent_required: Please accept the Privacy Policy and Terms to continue.
errors.conflict: This changed on the server while you were offline. Discard this and redo it from the latest version.
errors.idempotency_required: Could not send this action. Please try again.
errors.reauth_required: Please confirm it is you, then try again.
errors.date_invalid: Pick a day inside this cycle, before today.

cycle.settleConfirm: Generate the settlement for {{range}}? The cycle will be locked: nobody can add, edit or delete its expenses afterwards. Mistakes are fixed with an adjustment in the open cycle.
cycle.settleEarlyNote: This cycle is still running. Settling now closes it up to yesterday; today's expenses move to a new cycle.
cycle.lockedNote: This cycle is locked. Expenses can't be changed. Admins can add an adjustment to correct mistakes.
cycle.untilQuestion: Settle expenses up to which day?
cycle.untilHint: Expenses after this day move to the next cycle.
cycle.settleUntilNote: Expenses after {{date}} move to the next cycle.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.whoPaysWhomNote: Suggested transfers that settle everyone with the fewest payments.

payment.proofRequired: For bank, wallet or other payments, add a screenshot or a reference number.
payment.cashNote: For cash, the Admin's confirmation that cash was received is the record.

receipt.title: Receipt (optional)
receipt.attachedOffline: Saved on this phone — uploads when online

files.cameraDenied: Camera permission is needed to take a photo.
files.offline: No connection. The file is kept on your phone.

adjust.title: Adjust this expense
adjust.explain: This expense is in a locked cycle. Add a correction to the open cycle. Use a negative amount to reduce (e.g. -2.500).
adjust.label: Adjustment

settings.title: Room settings
settings.name: Room name
settings.effectiveNext: Saved. The new time zone / cycle applies from {{date}}, the start of the next cycle.
settings.currencyRule: Currency can only change at the start of a new cycle, before its first expense, with the previous cycle settled.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete this Room? Only possible when no other members remain and nothing is unsettled.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.k_join_rejected: Your request to join {{room}} was declined
inbox.k_admin_promoted: You are now an Admin of {{room}}
inbox.k_expense_late_entry: “{{title}}” was added as a late entry — its cycle was settled meanwhile (original date {{date}})
inbox.k_retention_reminder: Records of {{room}} for {{from}} – {{to}} will be deleted on {{deleteOn}}. Download your reports now.
inbox.k_payment_reminder: Reminder: please pay {{amount}} for {{room}} ({{from}} – {{to}}), due {{due}}. Mark it as paid in the app after paying.
inbox.k_confirm_reminder: {{count}} payment(s) in {{room}} are waiting for your confirmation.

notifPrefs.title: Notification settings
notifPrefs.intro: Money, membership and dispute notifications are always on. You can turn these off:
notifPrefs.pushOn: Push notifications are on for this phone.
notifPrefs.pushWeb: Push notifications arrive in the phone app. In the browser, check this inbox.
notifPrefs.pushDenied: Push permission was not given. You will still see everything in this inbox.
notifPrefs.needSoundHelp: A longer bell sound (about 4 seconds) and long vibration, so everyone in the Room notices a new Need Request. Swipe the notification away to stop it.
notifPrefs.needSoundPreview: This is how a new Need Request sounds.

flag.title: Report a problem
flag.explain: Admins and the person who added this item will be told. It stays visible to all members as “Under dispute” until resolved.
flag.acceptHint: Accepting records the decision. Correct the item with an edit (open cycle) or an adjustment (locked cycle).

need.title: Need Requests
need.explain: Everyone gets a notification. Whoever accepts buys it — no duplicates.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.restart: Restart the app to apply the new layout direction.
prefs.restartManual: Please close the app completely and open it again to apply the new layout direction.
prefs.draftTranslation: This language is a draft translation and will be reviewed by native speakers before release.

lock.title: App Lock
lock.explain: Ask for a PIN or fingerprint when the app opens and after it has been away for a while.
lock.unsupportedWeb: App Lock is available in the phone app.
lock.tooMany: Too many wrong PINs. Wait {{seconds}} seconds.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.pinBody: Enter your App Lock PIN to continue.
reauth.noMethod: This account has no password. Set up App Lock in Preferences first.
reauth.wrong: That did not match. Try again.

profile.title: One more step
profile.body: Please confirm your date of birth and accept the terms to start using Mess Manager.

sync.offlineBanner: You're offline — showing the last synced data
sync.title: Waiting to sync
sync.discardConfirm: Discard this item? It has not reached the server and will be lost.
sync.estimated: Estimated — not yet synced. Official totals come only from the server.
sync.logoutWarning: {{count}} item(s) on this phone have not synced yet and will be lost if you sign out. Sign out anyway?

report.title: Reports
report.explain: Download a PDF or CSV of expenses, settlements, payments, disputes and history. Each report has a reference number so anyone can check it is genuine.
report.needsInternet: This needs an internet connection. Please try again when you are online.
report.retentionNote: Mess Manager keeps records for 2 complete calendar months after a cycle is settled, then deletes them. Downloaded and emailed reports are your permanent copy.
report.deleteOn: The oldest records in this report will be deleted on {{date}}.
report.verifyFound: Genuine — this report was created by Mess Manager on {{date}} (UTC).
report.verifyNotFound: No report with this reference number was found.
report.verifyNote: Reference {{ref}} can be checked in the Mess Manager app under Reports → Check a report.
report.membersNote: Totals for this period for everyone in the Room — the same numbers as the Balances tab.

account.title: Your data and account
account.exportExplain: Download everything Mess Manager holds about you: your profile, your Rooms and your own records.
account.name: Name
account.whatHappens: What happens when you delete your account
account.what1: You are signed out at once and cannot sign in again. Your photo, App Lock, notification settings and devices are removed, and you leave all your Rooms today.
account.what2: Your financial records stay read-only until {{date}} — only for the Room's accounts and disputes, never for ads or marketing. Others will see your name as “(account deleted)”.
account.what3: On that date you (at your email) and your former Room members receive a final PDF statement, then everything linked to you is permanently deleted, including your email address.
account.lastAdmin: You are the only Admin of: {{rooms}}. Make another member an Admin first, then come back.
account.warnUnsynced: {{count}} item(s) on this phone have not synced and will be lost.
account.warnUnpaid: You still have {{count}} unpaid settlement(s). Deleting does not cancel what you owe.
account.warnDisputes: You have {{count}} open dispute(s). They will be resolved without you.
account.notReady: Account deletion is being switched on. Please try again later.

email.footer: You receive this because you have a Mess Manager account. This is an automatic message — please do not reply.
email.retention_subject: Records of {{room}} ({{from}} – {{to}}) will be deleted on {{date}}
email.retention_body: Mess Manager keeps records for 2 complete calendar months after a cycle is settled. The records of {{room}} for {{from}} – {{to}} will be deleted on {{date}}. Your statement is attached as PDF and CSV — please keep it, it is your permanent copy.
email.leave_body: You have left {{room}}. Attached is your statement for your stay ({{from}} – {{to}}): expenses, settlements, payments and anything still outstanding.
email.removed_body: You were removed from {{room}}. Attached is your statement for your stay ({{from}} – {{to}}): expenses, settlements, payments and anything still outstanding.
email.deleted_subject: Your Mess Manager account has been deleted
email.deleted_body: Your Mess Manager account has been deleted. Your financial records stay read-only until {{date}}, only for the accounts and disputes of your former Rooms. On that date you will receive a final statement, and then all data linked to you, including this email address, is permanently deleted.
email.final_body: The 2-month hold after your account deletion has ended. Your final statement is attached. All remaining data linked to you is now permanently deleted.
email.member_final_body: {{name}} deleted their Mess Manager account two months ago. Their final statement for {{room}} is attached. Their remaining data is now permanently deleted.
email.confirm_subject: Confirm deleting your Mess Manager account
email.confirm_body: We received a request to delete the Mess Manager account for this email address. If it was you, open the link below within 24 hours and confirm. If it was not you, ignore this email — nothing will change.

webPush.title: Phone notifications
webPush.explain: Get a notification on this phone when someone asks for something (Need Request), adds an expense, or a settlement is ready — even when this site is closed.
webPush.on: Notifications are on for this browser. You will be told about Need Requests and other Room news even when the site is closed.
webPush.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings (lock icon next to the address), then come back.
webPush.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. On Android use Chrome; on iPhone first tap Share → Add to Home Screen and open Mess Manager from there.

ads.label: Ad
ads.title: Ads
ads.explain: Mess Manager is free because of small ads. Your expenses, receipts and Room details are never shared with advertisers.

adFree.title: Remove ads
adFree.explain: Don't want to see banners? Subscribe and Mess Manager shows no ads on any of your phones. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
adFree.manage: Manage or cancel in Google Play
adFree.active: Ad-free until {{date}} (renews automatically unless cancelled). Thank you!
adFree.thanks: Thank you! Ads are now off on all your phones.
adFree.pending: Payment is pending. Ads turn off as soon as Google confirms it.
adFree.error: The purchase could not be confirmed. If you were charged, tap Restore later; Google refunds purchases that are not confirmed within 3 days.
adFree.notAvailable: Subscriptions are not available yet. They will appear once the app is published on Google Play.

crash.title: Something went wrong on this screen
crash.body: Your records are safe. Tap "Try again". If it keeps happening, we have been told automatically (no personal data is sent).

legalCard.title: Privacy Policy & Terms
legalCard.withdrawNote: You accepted these when you signed up. If you no longer agree, you can withdraw your consent by deleting your account — your Room records are kept read-only for 2 months, then erased.
